auditName: EOS Platform Audit & Capability Readiness Report

summary.topRisk: EOS has broad local read and display capability, but production readiness depends on governed writes, restore validation, security, connectors, and executable workflows.
summary.recommendedNextProgram: Enterprise Data Ingestion & Governed Execution Foundation
summary.recommendedNextAction: Build Data Source Connector Framework, then AI Extraction & Enterprise Object Generation, then Persistent Write API & Governance Audit Ledger.

statusTaxonomy.meaning: Implemented, exposed through API or UI, covered by automated verification, and currently usable for its intended local scope.
Core model, data, API, UI, and verification exist, but production execution, external integrations, or governance depth remain incomplete.
Visible to executives, but actions are intentionally non-executable until permissions, persistence, or external systems are added.
A usable foundation exists, but important workflow, extraction, persistence, UX, or verification gaps remain.
Reserved in the product experience or data model, with no substantive operational behavior yet.
A surface exists but is known to fail verification or core user flow checks.
Identified as required future work but not implemented in the platform.

capabilityReadinessMatrix.name: Enterprise Object Registry
capabilityReadinessMatrix.implementationDepth: Read registry, lookup by id, live status decoration, persistence-backed seed refresh.
capabilityReadinessMatrix.recommendedNextStep: Add governed object creation and audit ledger before external enterprise onboarding writes.

capabilityReadinessMatrix.name: EOS Agent Service
capabilityReadinessMatrix.implementationDepth: Seeded executive agent registry with API lookup and Mission Control display.
capabilityReadinessMatrix.recommendedNextStep: Build Agent Performance & Rewards after temporary agent creation is defined.

capabilityReadinessMatrix.name: Knowledge Service
capabilityReadinessMatrix.implementationDepth: Seeded knowledge registry and read APIs.
capabilityReadinessMatrix.frontendStatus: Visible through KIPR and Knowledge Vault
capabilityReadinessMatrix.recommendedNextStep: Connect organization intake outputs to KIPR records through governed writes.

capabilityReadinessMatrix.name: Workflow Engine
capabilityReadinessMatrix.implementationDepth: Seeded workflow registry with emitted events and API lookup.
capabilityReadinessMatrix.recommendedNextStep: Add persistent write API and governance audit ledger before real workflow execution.

capabilityReadinessMatrix.name: GitHub Readiness Assessment

capabilityReadinessMatrix.name: Live Object Status Layer
capabilityReadinessMatrix.implementationDepth: Live status interface applied across Enterprise Objects and surfaced in Mission Control.
capabilityReadinessMatrix.frontendStatus: Visible in object and portfolio displays

capabilityReadinessMatrix.name: Agent Knowledge Repository

capabilityReadinessMatrix.frontendStatus: Visible in KIPR and Knowledge Vault

capabilityReadinessMatrix.name: Knowledge Asset Viewer & Status Refinement

capabilityReadinessMatrix.recommendedNextStep: Add governed content generation and publication review queue.

capabilityReadinessMatrix.name: Program Management Office & Master Roadmap
capabilityReadinessMatrix.implementationDepth: PMO, Master Roadmap, programs, milestones, capability references, and Mission Control PMO view.

placeholderRegister.reason: Stop, restart, restore, clone, scale, and upgrade actions are intentionally non-executable until authorization, backup, restore validation, and audit controls mature.
placeholderRegister.recommendedCapability: Persistent Write API & Governance Audit Ledger

placeholderRegister.reason: Command palette displays executive search and command examples but does not execute actions.
Agent communication records are local seeded messages; no external chat or message send flow exists.
Agent calendar is local and seeded; no Google Calendar or scheduling integration is connected.
Telemetry exists as simulated records; live enterprise data connectors are not connected.
Organization intake can store records and basic metadata, but AI extraction and object generation are not implemented.
DTA candidates and Digital Mirrors exist; governed formation, approval, and promotion are not executable.
Valuation is an internal estimate and not audited financial valuation.
Backups are generated and checksummed, but restore validation remains pending.
GitHub and Google Drive readiness exist, but no remote repository, upload, or sync execution is enabled.

technicalDebtRegister.summary: EOS version is duplicated across root package, backend package, status controller, platform operations, release metadata, and verification scripts.
technicalDebtRegister.recommendedAction: Create a single build/version source module used by scripts and backend services.

technicalDebtRegister.summary: Backend verification is comprehensive but monolithic, making capability-specific checks harder to maintain.
technicalDebtRegister.recommendedAction: Split endpoint verification into capability-scoped test modules.

technicalDebtRegister.summary: Mission Control routing and data loading are concentrated in App.jsx.
technicalDebtRegister.recommendedAction: Introduce route/view registry and per-workspace data loaders.

technicalDebtRegister.summary: Local JSON persistence works for Alpha but lacks schema enforcement, transactions, and concurrent write protections.
technicalDebtRegister.recommendedAction: Add schema validation and prepare PostgreSQL migration path.

technicalDebtRegister.summary: Authentication, authorization, role enforcement, and audit ledger writes are not implemented for real operations.
technicalDebtRegister.recommendedAction: Build security and governed write foundations before enabling executable actions.

technicalDebtRegister.summary: Mission Control build checks pass, but there is no automated browser regression coverage for layout, upload previews, or presentation mode.
technicalDebtRegister.recommendedAction: Add Playwright smoke checks for primary workspaces and media upload previews.

readinessScores.interpretation: EOS has a strong local platform foundation with broad backend/API coverage, persistent storage, Mission Control views, and verification discipline.
Beta requires real data ingestion, executable workflows, stronger security, browser tests, and external sync.
Release Candidate readiness depends on production persistence, security, CI, deployments, observability, and recovery drills.
Version 1.0 requires commercial workflows, durable tenant model, enterprise onboarding execution, and audited governance controls.

qualityGates.evidence: Audit endpoint, script, data model, and automated verification are implemented.
Audit layer follows existing controller/service/data pattern; App.jsx and check-status remain large and should be decomposed.
Mission Control Platform / Audit view presents scores, matrix, gaps, placeholders, and debt in executive language.
Audit answers what works, what is display-only, what needs attention, and what should be built next.
Readiness scores and gaps make Alpha/Beta/V1 maturity transparent for investor conversations.
Audit identifies commercialization blockers and prioritizes connector, extraction, write governance, and DTA lifecycle work.
Audit documents platform maturity evidence and research gaps for the EOS Genesis and future publications.

recommendedBuildSequence.reason: EOS needs real enterprise source ingestion before Digital Mirrors and DTA candidates can move beyond seeded or manually structured records.
Imported organization documents must become structured Enterprise Objects, relationships, risks, assets, and DTA candidates.

recommendedBuildSequence.capability: Persistent Write API & Governance Audit Ledger
recommendedBuildSequence.reason: EOS needs safe create/update decisions, approvals, and audit history before executing real platform, workflow, or DTA operations.
Digital Mirrors and candidates must be promotable into governed DTAs through validation, approval, monitoring, optimization, and valuation stages.
dependencies: Persistent Write API & Governance Audit Ledger

recommendedBuildSequence.reason: The Second Balance Sheet thesis needs stronger internal valuation models, evidence, confidence levels, and governance review.

auditNotes: The audit classifies local functionality, not production fitness.
Display-only and placeholder items are intentional safety controls where execution would require permissions, persistence, security, or external integration.
No Broken items are currently registered by the audit model; browser-based probing should be added to validate UI flows such as upload preview and presentation mode.

liveStatus.summary: Platform Audit & Capability Readiness Center is available for executive review and automated reporting.
liveStatus.recommendedAction: Use the audit center to prioritize connector, extraction, governance write, DTA lifecycle, and valuation work.
